PluginData.Author: SentorX
PluginData.Tooltip: Live view, settings profiles and reports for the Advanced PB Limiter on your servers
PluginData.Description:
Live view, profiles and reports for the Advanced PB Limiter Magnetar plugin.
Live view: every tracked programmable block and player on a server, with run times, offences and memory. Turn off a block or all of a player's blocks. Needs permission to control servers.
Profiles: save a server's settings and privileged players under a name and apply them to other servers. Applying replaces both. A server that is offline or still loading gets the profile when it is ready. Needs permission to edit configurations. Limits are still set on the server's Plugins page.
Generate report: one text file for the servers you choose.
Needs the Advanced PB Limiter Magnetar plugin on the servers. Includes a small companion Magnetar plugin (advancedpblimiter.quasar) that Quasar adds to managed servers; restart servers that were running when this plugin was enabled. Each cluster node shows as its own server.
